A full rewrite: Rust and Tauri instead of the PowerShell script. Same idea, a lot more inside.

**Windows:** download `Deviload-2.0.0-setup.exe`. yt-dlp, FFmpeg and Deno are included. From now on Deviload updates itself.

**Mac (test build):** `Deviload-2.0.0-macos-test.zip`, unzip, move to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once. Not tested on a real Mac yet, feedback welcome.

**Coming from 1.x:** Deviload finds the old version and moves your history and settings over.

What's new

- Watch channels and playlists: new videos download by themselves
- Devil Cut, a video editor with a timeline, transitions, captions and music
- Phone link: send files to your phone and back with a QR code, or send a link to the queue
- One-click YouTube sign-in, proxy, yt-dlp updates itself daily
- Start with Windows, links from a text file, a copyable yt-dlp command in every task log
- English and Russian interface

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v1.1.0...v2.0.0
